claim: Of a cold circuit compile, what fraction is the on-GPU CDCL equivalence verification rather than the d-DNNF compile.

provenance.gpu: NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe, GPU-bdb502b0-1852-1504-5cd0-cafd7908b7e7, driver 580.159.04, 81920 MiB
provenance.note: recorded by the pod session that produced this file. The device UUID and CPU model are read from the triangle-counting artifact of that same session, which is the only file of the run whose runner records them; the environment probe of the run records the GPU name, driver and CPU quota directly.

protocol.programs: linear probabilistic reachability chains (0.5::edge(i,i+1) plus transitive path), fresh process per point so every compile is a real cache miss
protocol.metric: verify_pct_of_cold = verify / (d4_compile + verify + smooth + cache_store + cnf_hash + free_var_mask)
protocol.out_of_range: n >= 50 exceeds a CUDA grid-dimension limit on this CNF. This run stops at n = 40 and does not contain that observation: the sweep's own error stream was left on the pod and is not part of this record, so the limit is carried over from the earlier measurement rather than reproduced here.
